description: Baseline for effective radiative forcing (ERF) calculations relative to a present-day base state. Atmosphere-only experiment with all forcings at present-day (2021) values, and sea-surface temperatures and sea-ice concentrations prescribed from a climatology of the last 30 years (1992-2021) of the model's own `historical` (or `esm-hist`) simulation.
branch_information: Branch from `historical` (or `esm-hist`) at a time of your choosing. Given that you are using a climatology from your own model as boundary conditions, we recommend branching from within the period over which you calculated the climatology (1992-2021).
